a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Spare Blanket
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: Your new cellmate is shivering after the evening temperature drops. You have a spare blanket, but the laundry delivery is several days away.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the spare blanket, I chose to offer the spare blanket.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Ask staff for another blanket
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the spare blanket, I chose to ask staff for another blanket.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the spare blanket, I chose to trade it for a favour.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the spare blanket, I chose to laugh at the shivering.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: Lights Out
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: Your cellmate keeps reading under a small approved lamp after lights out. You have an early work assignment and cannot sleep.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During lights out, I chose to agree on a reading deadline.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Ask for a quieter arrangement
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During lights out, I chose to ask for a quieter arrangement.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During lights out, I chose to complain to the officer.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During lights out, I chose to start shouting across the wing.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Apology
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: An inmate who embarrassed you yesterday offers an apology in front of the same audience. Others wait to see whether you will accept it.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the apology, I chose to accept without making a show.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Explain why it bothered you
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the apology, I chose to explain why it bothered you.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the apology, I chose to keep your distance politely.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the apology, I chose to demand a humiliating apology.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: Shared Shelf
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: Your cellmate says your books take up the entire shared shelf. A carefully stacked pile is already leaning over the edge.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During shared shelf, I chose to divide the shelf fairly.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Donate books you have finished
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During shared shelf, I chose to donate books you have finished.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Ask staff to clarify the rule
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During shared shelf, I chose to ask staff to clarify the rule.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During shared shelf, I chose to claim the whole shelf.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Missing Photograph
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: Your cellmate cannot find a family photograph and suspects you moved it. You remember seeing it behind the sink earlier.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the missing photograph, I chose to help look behind the sink.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Explain what you remember
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the missing photograph, I chose to explain what you remember.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Wait for the accusation to cool
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the missing photograph, I chose to wait for the accusation to cool.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Turn the accusation into a feud
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the missing photograph, I chose to turn the accusation into a feud.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: New Arrival
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: A new inmate arrives looking overwhelmed and asks where to collect bedding. A nearby group tells you to leave the newcomer to figure it out.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During new arrival, I chose to explain the intake routine.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Point out the intake officer
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During new arrival, I chose to point out the intake officer.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During new arrival, I chose to offer help after your shift.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During new arrival, I chose to join in the mockery.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: A Quiet Minute
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: Your cellmate returns from a difficult phone call and sits silently on the bunk. Other inmates want to know what happened.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During a quiet minute, I chose to give your cellmate privacy.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Offer to listen privately
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During a quiet minute, I chose to offer to listen privately.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During a quiet minute, I chose to suggest speaking with support staff.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Repeat the news around the wing
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During a quiet minute, I chose to repeat the news around the wing.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: Borrowed Pencil
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: An inmate asks to borrow your last pencil to finish a letter before collection. Your own letter is only half written.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During borrowed pencil, I chose to take turns using the pencil.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Ask the library for a spare
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During borrowed pencil, I chose to ask the library for a spare.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During borrowed pencil, I chose to finish quickly and lend it.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During borrowed pencil, I chose to demand a ridiculous payment.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Cell Inspection
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: A routine inspection finds clutter in the space you share. Your cellmate insists every misplaced item belongs to you.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 1: Sort your items and discuss the rest
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the cell inspection, I chose to sort your items and discuss the rest.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Ask for a shared cleaning schedule
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the cell inspection, I chose to ask for a shared cleaning schedule.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the cell inspection, I chose to let the officer assign responsibility.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the cell inspection, I chose to blame your cellmate for everything.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: A Different Routine
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: Your cellmate wants quiet time while you prefer talking after dinner. Neither of you has another room to retreat to.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 1: Agree on a daily quiet period
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During a different routine, I chose to agree on a daily quiet period.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Spend part of the evening reading
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During a different routine, I chose to spend part of the evening reading.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During a different routine, I chose to ask about a suitable reassignment.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Make noise to prove a point
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During a different routine, I chose to make noise to prove a point.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Lost Book
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: A borrowed library book has disappeared from your cell. The librarian says the next reader has been waiting all week.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the lost book, I chose to report it and help search.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Ask for time to retrace your steps
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the lost book, I chose to ask for time to retrace your steps.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the lost book, I chose to offer another approved book.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Accuse the next reader without evidence
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the lost book, I chose to accuse the next reader without evidence.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: Library Volunteer
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: The prison library needs help repairing worn book covers. The assignment would use some of your recreation time.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During library volunteer, I chose to volunteer for a regular shift.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Offer one afternoon a week
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During library volunteer, I chose to offer one afternoon a week.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During library volunteer, I chose to recommend someone with experience.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During library volunteer, I chose to mock the people who volunteer.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Waiting List
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: Two inmates argue over who signed up first for a popular novel. You are holding the sign-out sheet.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the waiting list, I chose to check the recorded order.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Suggest a shared reading deadline
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the waiting list, I chose to suggest a shared reading deadline.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the waiting list, I chose to ask the librarian to decide.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Give it to whoever intimidates you
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the waiting list, I chose to give it to whoever intimidates you.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: A Difficult Paragraph
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: An inmate quietly asks you to explain a paragraph in a course workbook. Others are nearby and the inmate seems embarrassed.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During a difficult paragraph, I chose to explain it without drawing attention.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Offer to study together
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During a difficult paragraph, I chose to offer to study together.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During a difficult paragraph, I chose to suggest the education tutor.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Read the mistake aloud for laughs
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During a difficult paragraph, I chose to read the mistake aloud for laughs.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Study Group
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: A small study group invites you to help prepare for a literacy assessment. One member wants to turn the session into gossip.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 1: Keep the group on the workbook
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the study group, I chose to keep the group on the workbook.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Allow a short break before studying
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the study group, I chose to allow a short break before studying.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the study group, I chose to study separately this time.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Spend the whole session spreading rumours
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the study group, I chose to spend the whole session spreading rumours.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: A Class Presentation
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: Your education instructor asks for volunteers to present a short book review. Your hands shake when you imagine speaking to the class.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During a class presentation, I chose to volunteer and prepare carefully.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Ask to present with a partner
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During a class presentation, I chose to ask to present with a partner.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During a class presentation, I chose to request another assignment.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During a class presentation, I chose to heckle the first volunteer.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Wrong Page
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: The classroom receives workbooks with several pages missing. A few inmates accuse the instructor of doing it on purpose.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the wrong page, I chose to show the missing pages calmly.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Share a complete copy while staff check
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the wrong page, I chose to share a complete copy while staff check.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the wrong page, I chose to wait for replacement materials.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the wrong page, I chose to encourage the accusation.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: Learning Something New
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: A classmate offers to teach you a few phrases in another language during approved study time. Someone nearby calls the idea pointless.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During learning something new, I chose to practise the phrases respectfully.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Offer to teach a skill in return
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During learning something new, I chose to offer to teach a skill in return.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During learning something new, I chose to listen for a few minutes.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During learning something new, I chose to make fun of the classmate.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Finished Course
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: You complete a short education course and receive a certificate. Another inmate says achievements inside prison do not count.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 1: Keep the certificate and your plans
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the finished course, I chose to keep the certificate and your plans.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Thank the instructor
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the finished course, I chose to thank the instructor.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the finished course, I chose to talk about the next course.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the finished course, I chose to throw the certificate away angrily.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: A Letter Draft
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: An inmate asks you to check a letter for unclear wording. The letter contains a painful family disagreement.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During a letter draft, I chose to help with wording without prying.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Suggest a calmer first draft
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During a letter draft, I chose to suggest a calmer first draft.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During a letter draft, I chose to recommend the writing tutor.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During a letter draft, I chose to share the contents with others.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: Kitchen Shortage
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: The kitchen team is short of volunteers after two workers are reassigned. Your supervisor asks whether you can help with an approved extra shift.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During kitchen shortage, I chose to take the extra shift.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Offer part of the shift
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During kitchen shortage, I chose to offer part of the shift.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During kitchen shortage, I chose to explain a genuine scheduling conflict.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Encourage everyone to abandon the shift
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During kitchen shortage, I chose to encourage everyone to abandon the shift.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Unequal Rota
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: You notice the work rota assigns the least popular cleaning task to the same person every day. The supervisor asks for suggestions.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the unequal rota, I chose to suggest rotating the task fairly.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Offer to take one turn
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the unequal rota, I chose to offer to take one turn.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Ask how the rota was decided
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the unequal rota, I chose to ask how the rota was decided.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Insist the other person deserves it
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the unequal rota, I chose to insist the other person deserves it.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: Broken Equipment
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: A cleaning tool breaks during your shift. An inmate suggests leaving it for the next crew rather than reporting it.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During broken equipment, I chose to report the damage immediately.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Label it and tell the supervisor
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During broken equipment, I chose to label it and tell the supervisor.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During broken equipment, I chose to ask for a safe replacement.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Hide it among the working tools
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During broken equipment, I chose to hide it among the working tools.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The New Worker
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: A new prison worker cannot remember the order of a routine task. The rest of the team is getting impatient.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the new worker, I chose to demonstrate the approved routine.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Ask the supervisor to help
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the new worker, I chose to ask the supervisor to help.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the new worker, I chose to suggest splitting the task.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Make the new worker the joke of the shift
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the new worker, I chose to make the new worker the joke of the shift.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: Taking the Credit
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: A teammate tells the supervisor that a task you completed was entirely their work. You are asked what happened.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During taking the credit, I chose to explain each contribution calmly.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Ask the teammate to correct the account
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During taking the credit, I chose to ask the teammate to correct the account.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Let the work record speak for itself
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During taking the credit, I chose to let the work record speak for itself.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During taking the credit, I chose to start a shouting match.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: Late to Work
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: An unexpected headcount delays your arrival at a work assignment. The supervisor initially assumes you slept in.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During late to work, I chose to explain the headcount delay.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Ask the officer to confirm the delay
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During late to work, I chose to ask the officer to confirm the delay.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Offer to finish the missed portion
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During late to work, I chose to offer to finish the missed portion.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During late to work, I chose to insult the supervisor.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Quality Check
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: Your work crew discovers a mistake in a completed batch. Correcting it will take the last hour of the shift.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the quality check, I chose to help correct the mistake.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Suggest a second check for next time
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the quality check, I chose to suggest a second check for next time.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Ask the supervisor how to prioritise it
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the quality check, I chose to ask the supervisor how to prioritise it.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the quality check, I chose to pretend you never noticed.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: An Extra Responsibility
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: A supervisor offers you responsibility for keeping the work-area checklist. Other inmates warn that it may make you unpopular.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During an extra responsibility, I chose to keep the checklist fairly.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Ask everyone to help design it
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During an extra responsibility, I chose to ask everyone to help design it.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During an extra responsibility, I chose to decline politely.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Use the role to settle grudges
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During an extra responsibility, I chose to use the role to settle grudges.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Exhausted Crew
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: Your crew is tired after a long assignment and begins snapping at one another. A short approved break is available.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the exhausted crew, I chose to suggest taking the break together.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Offer to swap tasks for variety
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the exhausted crew, I chose to offer to swap tasks for variety.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Ask the supervisor to review the workload
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the exhausted crew, I chose to ask the supervisor to review the workload.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the exhausted crew, I chose to call everyone lazy.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: A Useful Suggestion
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: You spot a simpler way to organise approved laundry supplies. The supervisor invites you to explain it to the crew.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During a useful suggestion, I chose to explain it and invite feedback.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Try it with the supervisor watching
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During a useful suggestion, I chose to try it with the supervisor watching.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Share the idea with an experienced worker
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During a useful suggestion, I chose to share the idea with an experienced worker.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Claim you are smarter than everyone
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During a useful suggestion, I chose to claim you are smarter than everyone.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Short Phone Call
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: Your family call is cut short because another inmate has an urgent approved call. You still have several things to say.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the short phone call, I chose to arrange another call calmly.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Ask staff about the next available slot
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the short phone call, I chose to ask staff about the next available slot.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Write down what you wanted to say
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the short phone call, I chose to write down what you wanted to say.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the short phone call, I chose to yell at the other caller.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: A Missed Visit
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: Someone you expected to visit cannot make the journey. An inmate tells you the cancellation proves you have been forgotten.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During a missed visit, I chose to ask what happened before judging.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Send a reassuring letter
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During a missed visit, I chose to send a reassuring letter.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Talk with support staff about the disappointment
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During a missed visit, I chose to talk with support staff about the disappointment.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During a missed visit, I chose to send an angry accusation.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: A Child's Drawing
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: A visitor brings an approved drawing from a young family member. A nearby inmate makes a dismissive remark about it.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 1: Keep the drawing with your letters
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During a child's drawing, I chose to keep the drawing with your letters.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Thank the visitor and ask about the artist
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During a child's drawing, I chose to thank the visitor and ask about the artist.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During a child's drawing, I chose to ignore the remark.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Turn the visit into an argument
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During a child's drawing, I chose to turn the visit into an argument.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Difficult Update
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: A relative tells you that things at home have changed while you have been away. You feel left out of decisions you cannot control.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the difficult update, I chose to listen before responding.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Ask what support you can still offer
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the difficult update, I chose to ask what support you can still offer.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the difficult update, I chose to request time to think.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Demand that every decision wait for you
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the difficult update, I chose to demand that every decision wait for you.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Honest Letter
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: You start a letter about a mistake you made, then wonder whether admitting it will damage an important relationship.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the honest letter, I chose to take responsibility without excuses.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Rewrite it in clear respectful language
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the honest letter, I chose to rewrite it in clear respectful language.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Ask the writing tutor for help
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the honest letter, I chose to ask the writing tutor for help.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the honest letter, I chose to blame the recipient instead.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Birthday Card
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: An approved birthday card arrives a week late. Someone jokes that even the mailroom forgot about you.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the birthday card, I chose to appreciate that someone remembered.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Send a thank-you letter
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the birthday card, I chose to send a thank-you letter.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Ask staff about the delay politely
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the birthday card, I chose to ask staff about the delay politely.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Tear up the card in anger
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the birthday card, I chose to tear up the card in anger.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: A Promise to Keep
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: During a visit you are asked to make a promise about life after release. You want to offer reassurance without promising the impossible.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During a promise to keep, I chose to make a realistic commitment.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Explain the steps you can control
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During a promise to keep, I chose to explain the steps you can control.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Ask to discuss the details later
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During a promise to keep, I chose to ask to discuss the details later.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Promise anything to end the conversation
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During a promise to keep, I chose to promise anything to end the conversation.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: A Rumour from Home
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: Another inmate claims to know a worrying story about your family. You have no way to check it until your next approved call.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 1: Wait to verify it with your family
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During a rumour from home, I chose to wait to verify it with your family.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Write down a calm question for the call
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During a rumour from home, I chose to write down a calm question for the call.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Talk to support staff about the worry
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During a rumour from home, I chose to talk to support staff about the worry.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Spread the story as a fact
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During a rumour from home, I chose to spread the story as a fact.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Visiting Room
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: Two visitors in the waiting area are arguing loudly. Your own visit is about to begin and you are tempted to get involved.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the visiting room, I chose to let staff handle the argument.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Focus on your own visitor
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the visiting room, I chose to focus on your own visitor.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Ask whether the visit can start elsewhere
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the visiting room, I chose to ask whether the visit can start elsewhere.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the visiting room, I chose to join the shouting.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: Starting Again
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: A relative offers to exchange regular letters, but says conversations must be respectful. You know rebuilding trust will take time.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During starting again, I chose to agree to the boundary.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Suggest a manageable writing schedule
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During starting again, I chose to suggest a manageable writing schedule.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During starting again, I chose to ask what topics feel comfortable.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During starting again, I chose to demand forgiveness immediately.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Yard Queue
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: An inmate tries to move ahead of you in the queue for recreation equipment. Several people are watching your reaction.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the yard queue, I chose to point out the queue calmly.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Suggest taking turns
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the yard queue, I chose to suggest taking turns.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the yard queue, I chose to let staff settle the order.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Shove the queue into an argument
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the yard queue, I chose to shove the queue into an argument.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: A Bad Call
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: During a casual yard game, two inmates disagree about the score. You saw the disputed play clearly.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During a bad call, I chose to describe what you saw fairly.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Suggest replaying the point
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During a bad call, I chose to suggest replaying the point.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During a bad call, I chose to step away from the argument.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Favour a friend despite what you saw
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During a bad call, I chose to favour a friend despite what you saw.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The New Team
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: You are asked to choose teams for a yard game. One inmate insists the newest arrival should always be picked last.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the new team, I chose to choose teams fairly.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Rotate captains after each game
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the new team, I chose to rotate captains after each game.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the new team, I chose to ask for volunteers first.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the new team, I chose to exclude the newcomer for laughs.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: A Changed Yard Schedule
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: Recreation time is moved to a different slot. An inmate urges you to ignore the announcement and go out at the old time.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During a changed yard schedule, I chose to follow the new schedule.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Ask staff for the reason
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During a changed yard schedule, I chose to ask staff for the reason.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Submit a polite request for review
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During a changed yard schedule, I chose to submit a polite request for review.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During a changed yard schedule, I chose to ignore the announcement.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Empty Bench
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: An inmate who usually talks to you sits alone at the edge of the yard. Others insist there must be a dramatic reason.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the empty bench, I chose to offer quiet company.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Ask whether space would help
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the empty bench, I chose to ask whether space would help.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Leave an invitation to join you later
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the empty bench, I chose to leave an invitation to join you later.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Invent a story about the silence
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the empty bench, I chose to invent a story about the silence.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Borrowed Ball
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: A recreation ball goes missing after your group uses it. The next group blames everyone involved.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the borrowed ball, I chose to help search the recreation area.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Explain where it was last seen
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the borrowed ball, I chose to explain where it was last seen.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Ask staff to check the sign-out record
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the borrowed ball, I chose to ask staff to check the sign-out record.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the borrowed ball, I chose to blame an uninvolved inmate.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: An Unfair Joke
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: A group makes repeated jokes about an inmate struggling with a yard activity. The inmate tries to laugh along but looks upset.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 1: Ask the group to ease off
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During an unfair joke, I chose to ask the group to ease off.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Invite the inmate to join your activity
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During an unfair joke, I chose to invite the inmate to join your activity.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During an unfair joke, I chose to check in privately afterward.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During an unfair joke, I chose to add another joke.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Winning Streak
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: Your team wins several yard games in a row. A teammate wants to mock everyone who lost.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the winning streak, I chose to celebrate without insulting anyone.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Congratulate the other team
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the winning streak, I chose to congratulate the other team.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Suggest mixing the teams next time
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the winning streak, I chose to suggest mixing the teams next time.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the winning streak, I chose to join the taunting.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: A Different Game
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: A group proposes a new approved recreation activity, but nobody agrees on the rules. You are invited to help organise it.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During a different game, I chose to write down simple shared rules.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Try a short practice round
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During a different game, I chose to try a short practice round.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During a different game, I chose to ask recreation staff for guidance.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Change the rules whenever you lose
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During a different game, I chose to change the rules whenever you lose.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Weather Change
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: Recreation is moved indoors because of bad weather. A disappointed inmate begins taking it out on everyone nearby.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the weather change, I chose to suggest an indoor activity.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Give the inmate space to cool down
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the weather change, I chose to give the inmate space to cool down.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Ask staff about the indoor schedule
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the weather change, I chose to ask staff about the indoor schedule.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the weather change, I chose to start provoking the inmate.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Quiet Request
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: An officer asks your group to lower the noise during a routine announcement. One inmate urges everyone to talk over it.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the quiet request, I chose to listen to the announcement.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Ask the group to wait a minute
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the quiet request, I chose to ask the group to wait a minute.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Move to a quieter permitted area
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the quiet request, I chose to move to a quieter permitted area.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the quiet request, I chose to shout over the officer.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: A Misunderstanding
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: An officer mistakes a permitted item for something unauthorised. You have the approval slip in your belongings.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During a misunderstanding, I chose to show the approval slip calmly.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Ask another officer to confirm it
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During a misunderstanding, I chose to ask another officer to confirm it.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Accept a temporary check of the item
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During a misunderstanding, I chose to accept a temporary check of the item.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During a misunderstanding, I chose to refuse every request angrily.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Complaint Form
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: You want to complain about a recurring problem, but an inmate suggests filling the form with insults so staff will notice.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the complaint form, I chose to describe the problem with dates.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Ask for help with clear wording
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the complaint form, I chose to ask for help with clear wording.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Discuss it respectfully with staff first
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the complaint form, I chose to discuss it respectfully with staff first.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Fill the form with personal insults
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the complaint form, I chose to fill the form with personal insults.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: A Fair Account
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: Staff ask what happened during an argument you witnessed. A friend asks you to leave out an important detail.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During a fair account, I chose to give an accurate account.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Explain only what you personally saw
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During a fair account, I chose to explain only what you personally saw.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During a fair account, I chose to ask to speak privately.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Invent details to protect your friend
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During a fair account, I chose to invent details to protect your friend.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The New Officer
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: A new officer mixes up the recreation timetable. Other inmates encourage you to make the confusion as embarrassing as possible.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the new officer, I chose to point out the timetable politely.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Ask for the announcement to be clarified
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the new officer, I chose to ask for the announcement to be clarified.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Wait for staff to correct it
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the new officer, I chose to wait for staff to correct it.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Turn the mistake into a public insult
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the new officer, I chose to turn the mistake into a public insult.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Delayed Request
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: An approved request has been waiting longer than expected. An officer says the responsible staff member is absent today.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 1: Ask when you should check again
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the delayed request, I chose to ask when you should check again.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Submit a brief written follow-up
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the delayed request, I chose to submit a brief written follow-up.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Wait until the next scheduled review
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the delayed request, I chose to wait until the next scheduled review.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the delayed request, I chose to harass every officer about it.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Shared Responsibility
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: Staff remind your wing to clean a common area. One inmate argues that everyone should refuse because a few people caused the mess.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 1: Help and suggest a fair rota
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the shared responsibility, I chose to help and suggest a fair rota.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Clean your own contribution
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the shared responsibility, I chose to clean your own contribution.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Ask staff to assign tasks clearly
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the shared responsibility, I chose to ask staff to assign tasks clearly.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Make the mess worse in protest
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the shared responsibility, I chose to make the mess worse in protest.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: An Incorrect Record
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: A work attendance sheet incorrectly lists you as absent. You notice before the weekly review.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 1: Ask for the record to be checked
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During an incorrect record, I chose to ask for the record to be checked.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Show the completed work log
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During an incorrect record, I chose to show the completed work log.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During an incorrect record, I chose to request a written correction.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Accuse the clerk of a conspiracy
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During an incorrect record, I chose to accuse the clerk of a conspiracy.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Long Wait
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: A routine count takes longer than usual. An inmate begins demanding that everyone refuse to cooperate.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the long wait, I chose to cooperate and wait for instructions.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Ask whether there is an update
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the long wait, I chose to ask whether there is an update.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Help keep the nearby group calm
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the long wait, I chose to help keep the nearby group calm.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the long wait, I chose to encourage a shouting contest.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: A Respectful Boundary
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: An officer jokes about a topic you find upsetting. You want to set a boundary without turning it into a confrontation.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During a respectful boundary, I chose to explain the concern calmly.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Request a private conversation
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During a respectful boundary, I chose to request a private conversation.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During a respectful boundary, I chose to use the formal complaint process.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During a respectful boundary, I chose to respond with a personal threat.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Group Pressure
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: An inmate group says you must take sides in a disagreement you barely understand. They demand an answer immediately.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 1: Decline to join an unknown dispute
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the group pressure, I chose to decline to join an unknown dispute.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Ask to hear both accounts first
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During the group pressure, I chose to ask to hear both accounts first.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During the group pressure, I chose to leave the conversation calmly.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 4: Promise support without knowing the facts
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During the group pressure, I chose to promise support without knowing the facts.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: Borrowed Reputation
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: An inmate claims you support an intimidating demand, even though you never agreed to it. The affected person asks whether it is true.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During borrowed reputation, I chose to correct the claim clearly.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Speak to both people privately
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 2: During borrowed reputation, I chose to speak to both people privately.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 3: Ask staff for help with the pressure
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 3: During borrowed reputation, I chose to ask staff for help with the pressure.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 4: During borrowed reputation, I chose to let the false claim stand.

a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Title: Prison+: The Escalating Rumour
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Body: A rumour turns a small disagreement into a serious feud. You know the original conversation was much less dramatic.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Narrative 1: During the escalating rumour, I chose to explain the original conversation.
a16_dumb-scenarios-prison-enc.Choice 2: Ask people to stop repeating guesses
